collection.title: BMW 6 Series Coupe 2004 to 2010 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a BMW 6 Series 2004 to 2010 model which requires a 23" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 24" for the passengers side. This model uses the Pinch Tab arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
